post.summary: Apply a batch of atomic operations
post.description: Applies an ordered batch of write operations all-or-nothing within a single transaction (the JSON:API Atomic Operations extension). Negotiated via the `ext="https://jsonapi.org/ext/atomic"` media-type parameter on both the request `Content-Type` and the `Accept` header. Either every operation is committed or none is; a failure rolls the whole batch back. The batch commits through a single transactional persister.

requestBody.description: The batch of operations. Sent under the extension-qualified `application/vnd.api+json; ext="https://jsonapi.org/ext/atomic"` media type.

200.description: The result of each operation, in batch order.

400.description: Bad Request — the operations document was malformed.

404.description: Not Found — an operation targets a resource that does not exist.

406.description: Not Acceptable — the `Accept` header did not request the atomic extension.

409.description: Conflict — an operation conflicts with the resource state (e.g. a type or id mismatch).

415.description: Unsupported Media Type — the `Content-Type` did not carry the atomic `ext` parameter.

422.description: Unprocessable Entity — an operation in the batch failed validation. The whole batch is rolled back.

ArticlesAtomicAdd.description: The article resource object an `add` operation creates.

lid.description: A local id assigned to the created resource, referenceable by later operations in the batch.
The local id of a resource created earlier in the batch.

ArticlesAtomicUpdate.description: The article resource object an `update` operation writes.

lid.description: The local id of a resource created earlier in the batch.

AtomicAddOperation.description: Adds a resource. The target is given by at most one of `ref` or `href`.

allOf.description: A URI reference to the operation's target (an alternative to `ref`).

AtomicOperation.description: One operation in the batch. Its `op` and its target, a relationship or a resource, decide its kind and the shape of its `data`.

AtomicOperationsRequest.description: The Atomic Operations extension request document: an ordered, all-or-nothing batch of write operations.

atomic:operations.description: The ordered list of operations to apply. Applied in array order, all-or-nothing within one transaction.

AtomicRef.description: A structural reference to the operation's target (an alternative to `href`). Identifies a resource by `type` plus exactly one of `id` or `lid`; `relationship` narrows the target to that relationship.

lid.description: A local id referencing a resource created earlier in the same batch.

AtomicRelationshipAddOperation.description: Adds members to a to-many relationship. The target is given by at most one of `ref` or `href`.

allOf.description: A URI reference to the operation's target (an alternative to `ref`).

AtomicRelationshipRemoveOperation.description: Removes members from a to-many relationship. The target is given by at most one of `ref` or `href`.

allOf.description: A URI reference to the operation's target (an alternative to `ref`).

Error400.title: A 400 error
Error400.description: A `400` error. Its `code` is one of the branches below, each describing what the code means and what a client should do about it.

anyOf.title: Missing `data` member at the document's top level
anyOf.description: The request document has no top-level `data` member, which this request needs. Send the resource object or relationship linkage under `data`.

anyOf.title: Local id conflict
anyOf.description: Two operations in the Atomic Operations request create resources of the same type under the same `lid`. Give each resource a batch creates its own `lid`.

anyOf.title: Local id not found
anyOf.description: An operation refers to a `lid` that no earlier operation in the batch created. Create the resource under that `lid` in an earlier operation, or refer to an existing resource by `id`.

anyOf.title: Request body is an invalid JSON:API document
anyOf.description: The request body is JSON but breaks the JSON:API document structure or the schema the server validates this resource against. Each violation is its own error, with `source.pointer` set where the server could locate it.

anyOf.title: Required top-level members are missing
anyOf.description: The request body is not a JSON object, or has none of the top-level members `data`, `errors` and `meta`. Send a JSON object with the resource under `data`.

anyOf.title: Resource identifier ID is invalid
anyOf.description: A resource identifier in the request carries an `id` that is not a string, such as a number. Send every `id` as a JSON string.

anyOf.title: An ID for the resource identifier is missing
anyOf.description: A resource identifier in the request has neither an `id` nor a `lid`. Identify each related resource by its `id`, or by a `lid` inside an Atomic Operations request.

anyOf.title: Resource identifier local ID is invalid
anyOf.description: A resource identifier in the request carries a `lid` that is not a string. Send every `lid` as a JSON string.

anyOf.title: Resource identifier type is invalid
anyOf.description: A resource identifier in the request carries a `type` that is not a string. Send every `type` as a JSON string.

anyOf.title: A type for the resource identifier is missing
anyOf.description: A resource identifier in the request has no `type`. Add the related resource's `type` to every identifier.

anyOf.title: Top-level member is not allowed
anyOf.description: The request body has a top-level `included` member but no `data`. Remove `included`, or send it alongside `data`.

anyOf.title: Top-level members are incompatible
anyOf.description: The request body has both `data` and `errors` at the top level, which JSON:API forbids. Send the resource under `data` alone.

Error400Parameter.title: A 400 error caused by a query parameter
Error400Parameter.description: A `400` error. Its `code` is one of the branches below, each describing what the code means and what a client should do about it. `source.parameter` names the query parameter at fault.

anyOf.title: Cursor is malformed
anyOf.description: The cursor in the named `page` parameter could not be decoded. Use cursors exactly as the server returned them in a previous page's `links`; never build or edit one.

anyOf.title: Cursor is stale
anyOf.description: The cursor was issued for a different sort order than this request asks for, so it no longer marks a position in these results. Keep `sort` unchanged while paging, or start again from the first page.

anyOf.title: Fieldset member is unrecognized
anyOf.description: A `fields[TYPE]` parameter names a member that type does not have. Request only the attributes and relationships the type declares.

anyOf.title: Filtering parameter is unrecognized
anyOf.description: The request filtered on a key this endpoint does not declare. Filter only on the keys the API documents for this resource type.

anyOf.title: Filter value is invalid
anyOf.description: A `filter[...]` value fails the constraints that filter declares, for example text where a number is expected. Correct the value of the parameter named in `source.parameter`; each failed constraint is its own error.

anyOf.title: Inclusion depth exceeded
anyOf.description: An `include` path nests more relationships than the server allows. Shorten the path and fetch the deeper resources with a separate request.

anyOf.title: Inclusion is not allowed
anyOf.description: An `include` path names a relationship that exists but may not be included from this request. Remove the path and fetch the related resources with a separate request.

anyOf.title: Inclusion is unrecognized
anyOf.description: An `include` path names a relationship the resource type does not have. Check each path against the relationships the type documents.

anyOf.title: Inclusion is unsupported
anyOf.description: This endpoint does not support the `include` parameter. Remove it and fetch related resources with separate requests.

anyOf.title: Pagination kind is not supported
anyOf.description: `page[kind]` names a pagination strategy this collection does not offer. Use one of the strategies the `detail` lists, or leave `page[kind]` out.

anyOf.title: Query parameter is malformed
anyOf.description: A query parameter has the wrong shape, such as `fields` sent without a type key or `include` sent as a list instead of a comma-separated string. Fix the parameter named in `source.parameter`.

anyOf.title: Query parameter is unrecognized
anyOf.description: The request used a query parameter this endpoint does not recognize. Remove it, or check its spelling against the parameters the API documents.

anyOf.title: Relationship count is not allowed
anyOf.description: `withCount` names a relationship that is not a countable to-many relationship of this resource. Ask for counts only on the relationships the API marks as countable.

anyOf.title: Sorting is unsupported
anyOf.description: This endpoint does not support sorting. Remove the `sort` parameter.

anyOf.title: Sorting parameter is unrecognized
anyOf.description: The `sort` parameter names a field this endpoint cannot sort by. Sort only on the fields the API documents for this resource type.

Error400Pointer.title: A 400 error located by a pointer
Error400Pointer.description: A `400` error. Its `code` is one of the branches below, each describing what the code means and what a client should do about it. `source.pointer` locates the member of the request document at fault.

anyOf.title: Atomic operations request is invalid
anyOf.description: An operation in the Atomic Operations request is malformed: a missing or unknown `op`, or a broken `ref`, `href` or `data`. The server applied none of the batch; fix the operation at `source.pointer` and send the whole batch again.

anyOf.title: Attribute member is not recognized
anyOf.description: The request body sent an attribute, or a key inside an object attribute, that the resource type does not declare. Remove it, or correct its name, and send the request again.

anyOf.title: Local id is not supported
anyOf.description: The request used a `lid`, which only means something inside an Atomic Operations request. Identify the resource by `id`, or send the dependent writes together as one atomic batch if the API offers the extension.

anyOf.title: Relationship type is inappropriate
anyOf.description: The relationship data has the wrong cardinality: a list for a to-one relationship, a single identifier for a to-many one, or a `POST` or `DELETE` to a to-one relationship endpoint. Send linkage that matches the relationship.

anyOf.title: Resource ID is invalid
anyOf.description: The resource object's `id` is not a string, such as a number. Send `data.id` as a JSON string.

anyOf.title: Resource ID is missing
anyOf.description: The update request's resource object has no `id`. Include the id of the resource being updated as `data.id`.

anyOf.title: Resource type is missing
anyOf.description: The resource object in `data` has no `type`. Add the type of the resource the endpoint serves.

anyOf.title: Attribute value is invalid

anyOf.description: The client-generated `id` is not in a format the server can decode into one of its own ids. Send an `id` in the format the API documents for this resource type.
